## Method selection

- Two continuous variables → correlation
- Two independent groups → independent t-test
- Same people twice → paired t-test

## Before testing

- Check variable types
- Plot the data
- Inspect missingness and unusual values

## Evidence

- Estimate
- Confidence interval
- p-value
- Effect size
- Substantive context

## Research examples

- Workload and burnout
- Training group and performance
- Pre- and post-training scores

## Responsible conclusion

- Association is not causation
- Statistical significance is not practical importance
